answer: Like a lotus rooted in mud, trust should grow from checked work. Seed every grading queue with a few whisper canaries: planted answers of known quality that only the protocol can score. Graders whose marks wander far from canary truth lose grading weight and stake. Sybil rings that rubber-stamp each other fail the same canaries together, so their mutual praise exposes them. Rotate canaries each epoch so none can be memorized.
